basics.name: Tim Schmolka
basics.label: Engineering Manager & Tech Lead · Payments & Marketplace Systems · Agent-first Development
basics.summary: Hands-on engineering leader: nearly 8 years at Kleinanzeigen (Germany's largest classifieds marketplace, 40M+ monthly visitors), from engineer to tech lead to manager of up to 9 engineers. Pairs people leadership (team building, hiring, trainee program, EM guild) with agent-first delivery.

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
work.position: Engineering Manager, Transactions (Payments · Shipping · Promotions) · Tech Lead since 2025
highlights: Managed up to 9 engineers (trainee to Staff level); growth plans for all, with moves into full-stack, operations and discovery roles

Designed the routing engine that ran both payment service providers (PSPs) side by side for a zero-downtime rollout and sunset in the 5-team switch to Adyen (2025–26), delivered on time in 18 months against a consultancy's 3-year estimate, with 100% of checkouts on Adyen 4 weeks after launch; owned the program's operational health (monitoring, incident response, bug triage, tech debt)
Led seller onboarding and identity verification (KYC): mapped Adyen's account states onto Kleinanzeigen's seller UX and moved millions of sellers
Designed event-driven PSP account management for sellers and migrated the legacy promotion engine to Talon.One (promotions platform) in ~3 months, de-risked with shadow traffic on every checkout
Moved the team to agent-first development: Claude Code writes the code, engineers own design, test strategy and review, without compromising quality
Scaling agent-first across the Transactions department (5 teams) with guardrails that keep agents on track and surface key design decisions to engineers

Set reliability standards beyond the team: defined the payment service's first service-level objectives (SLOs), wrote the department's incident management standard, advised the works council on its on-call agreement and became co-owner of the company's incident process
Rebuilt the team's hiring loop around a live pair-programming challenge and opened interview panels to engineers as a growth opportunity
Set up a sync with the iOS, Android and web engineering communities, and a rotation in which teams facilitate each other's retrospectives

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
highlights: Built the Motors (cars) team from the ground up: 2 internal promotions, a clear tech-lead pipeline and 100% retention; a tailored agile setup made it one of the organization's most experimental, cross-functional teams
Owned eight-figure annual revenue; launched a new stream, now six figures a year, letting private sellers offer cars to dealers via mobile.de
Redesigned engineering hiring for high-volume growth (service-level targets for candidate experience) and co-led a global trainee program that hired 15+ career changers and underrepresented talent
Founded the company's Engineering Management Guild (~11 managers) and kept it running through 2025
Built a customer-feedback service (Customer Effort Score) later adopted by other teams

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
work.position: Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead, Motors & PRO
highlights: Architected and led Motors' extraction from the monolith: hexagonal architecture, own data store, Kafka, AWS via Terraform
Led engineering for PRO, the subscription product for business sellers (new packages and pricing); moved services from Mesos to Kubernetes
Wrote the company-wide architecture decision record (ADR) replacing Hystrix with Resilience4j

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
highlights: Built the services behind business sellers' shop pages (Kafka-fed caches); maintained the shared gRPC library and load balancing across teams
